The '''98th "Laser Storm" Forward Observer Shuttle Wing''' was a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Fighter wing/Legends|flight wing]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. [[T. Alvak]] served in the 98th as an [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogator]] and emergency [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] for several [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="SWS" />
